title: Going Dotty
author: Banango
rules:
Normal sudoku rules apply: fill each cell with a digit from 1 to 9 such that each digit appears exactly once in its row column and box.

White kropki dots: Digits separated by a white dot differ by 1.

Click here to play!

Let me know how you tackled this, I am curious if my intended solve method is necessary or not.

This is my second puzzle that I'm sharing so any advice for a new setter is welcome. I have a couple of puzzle ideas that would require some things that I don't know how to do yet. If anybody knows how to create a sudoku where there are boxes outside the grid for notating, or sudoku with unorthodox rules (i.e. it is allowed to have multiple 1s in the same column) that would be appreciated as well.

I hope you enjoy!
